notes.decision: Page number 269. Coptic numerals: ⲥ=200, ⲍ here functions as ⲝ=60 (graphical/scribal variation), ⲑ=9; total 269. The bracketed restoration of [ⲍⲑ] is editorial.

ⲡⲓⲇ appears three times (lines 14, 16) flanking the chapter heading. Almost certainly a paragraph/section marker (perhaps abbreviation of παράγραφος or Coptic chapter-marker), not lexical content. Translated as '(¶)'.

Read as ⲛ̄(ⲇⲓ)ⲕⲁⲓⲟⲥ 'righteous' (Greek δίκαιος); the form shows scribal variation (loss of -ⲇⲓ-) but the sense is secured by Manichaean usage of ⲇⲓⲕⲁⲓⲟⲥ as a designation of the Elect (cf. accumulated ⲇⲓⲕⲁⲓⲟⲥ ⲛ̄ⲣⲙ̄ⲙⲏⲉ).

Read as 'the Illuminator' (= Mani). Likely an orthographic variant or scribal form of ⲡⲡⲛ̄ⲫⲱⲥⲧⲏⲣ 'our Illuminator' (in glossary) or ⲡⲓ-ⲫⲱⲥⲧⲏⲣ 'this Illuminator' with intrusive ⲛ. The ⲡⲓⲛϥ- cluster is unusual but the referent is unambiguous: Mani as φωστήρ addressing his disciples in standard Kephalaia narrative frame.
ⲉⲕⲩⲉⲕⲧⲟⲥ = ἐκλεκτός 'elect' with metathesis ⲩⲉⲕ for ⲗⲉⲕ. Standard Manichaean technical term for the elect (in glossary: ⲉⲕⲗⲉⲕⲧⲟⲥ ⲛ̄ⲧⲉⲗⲉⲓⲟⲥ).

Hendiadys 'the residue and the remainder' — both ⲥⲱⲭⲡ (Lyc. for ⲥⲱϫⲡ̄ 'remainder') and ⲥⲉⲡⲉ (= ⲥⲉⲡⲉ 'remainder/rest,' in glossary as ⲥⲉⲧⲧⲉ) are synonyms. The doublet emphasizes that the psychic icon is what remains/is left over of the New Man — i.e., the soul-icon distinct from the higher pneumatic Mind-icon.

'The Old Man' in Pauline anthropological register (παλαιὸς ἄνθρωπος, Eph 4:22, Col 3:9) — already in accumulated vocabulary as anthropological pair-partner with ⲡⲣⲙⲛⲃⲣⲣⲉ 'New Man.' Here glosses the somatic-flesh-bound icon.

Verb ⲃⲁϣⲥ̄ recurs in lines 29 and 31 with 3sg.f object — apparently a transitive verb of pouring/spreading the soul. Possibly Lyc. variant of ⲡⲱϣ 'spread, divide' or ⲃⲱⲣϣ̄ 'pour out.' Translated 'pour her' to capture the directional/transferring sense in the soul-descent context.

ⲟⲩⲏⲍ = Lyc. qualitative of ⲟⲩⲱⲍ/ⲟⲩⲱϩ 'add, place upon, contain' (cf. accumulated ϩⲟⲩⲱⲍ 'to add'). With ⲁⲣⲁⲩ 'upon them/over them' = 'which contains/encompasses them all' — the somatic icon as the bodily envelope of the higher two.

Tentatively translated 'of shining-forth' on the basis of the verbal root ⲡⲓⲉ/ⲡⲣⲓⲉ 'shine, radiate' (in glossary, same root as ⲡⲡⲣⲓ̈ⲉ 'the Radiance'). The ϩⲡ- prefix may be a Lyc. nominalizing element giving 'place/state of shining.' Confidence moderate; awaits parallel attestation. Alternatively could read 'of the hidden ones' (root ϩⲏⲡ).

Transcription has stray ⲝ and bracket ⲁⲙⲙⲁⲛ̄ⲝ]ⲟⲡⲉ; reading as ⲁ-ⲙ-ⲙⲁⲛϣⲟⲡⲉ 'to the dwelling-places' (ⲙⲁ-ⲛ̄-ϣⲱⲡⲉ 'place of becoming/dwelling,' cf. accumulated ⲙⲁⲛⲭⲓⲟⲡⲉ 'dwelling'). The ⲝ likely represents ϣ in Lyc. orthography.

ⲧⲣⲟⲫⲏ ⲛ̄ⲧⲃⲓⲟⲩⲱⲙ 'food of eating' — ⲃⲓⲟⲩⲱⲙ likely verbal noun ⲃⲓ-ⲟⲩⲱⲙ 'bringing-eating' or 'consumption.' Manichaean technical context: the soul-icon descends through the act of eating food, by which captive light is mingled into the body.

'The Living Ones' — standard Manichaean term for divine beings in the realm of light (cf. accumulated ⲡⲣⲕⲗⲏⲧⲟⲥ ⲉⲧⲁⲛⲍ̄ 'the Living Paraclete,' ⲡⲏⲓ̈ ⲛⲛⲉⲧⲁⲛⲍ̄ 'house of the Living Ones'). The chosen kind is brought up to the Living Ones above.
Lyc. ⲛ̄ϫⲁϫⲉ 'the enemies' (with regular Lyc. ⲝ for ϫ). The psychic icon is poured out unto the enemies — the dark powers/archons that war against the soul.
